name: Surging Strikes
description: Hits three times. This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
Power is multiplied by 1.2 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Iron Fist.
